ex.en: He always comes to show his appreciation during the New Year and holidays.
ex.zh: 每逢過年過節，他總會來表達謝意。

ex.en: Please accept this gift as a token of our appreciation.
ex.zh: 請收下這份禮物，聊表我們的謝意。

appreciation.en: a feeling of being thankful for something done for you

ex.en: She has a deep appreciation of classical music.
ex.zh: 她非常懂得欣賞古典音樂。

ex.en: The course gave me a better appreciation of art.
ex.zh: 這門課讓我更懂得欣賞藝術。

appreciation.en: the ability to see and enjoy the good qualities of something

ex.en: The appreciation of the yen hurt exports.
ex.zh: 日圓升值打擊了出口。

ex.en: Property appreciation has slowed this year.
ex.zh: 今年房地產增值的速度放緩了。

appreciation.en: a rise in the value of money or property over time

ex.en: You owe me an apology for that.
ex.zh: 關於那件事你欠我一個道歉。

ex.en: I must make an apology to her.
ex.zh: 我得向她道歉。

ex.en: Please accept my sincere apologies.
ex.zh: 請接受我誠摯的歉意。

apology.en: a statement saying you are sorry for doing something wrong

ex.en: He worked as an apprentice to a carpenter.
ex.zh: 他在一位木匠手下當學徒。

ex.en: The company hires five apprentices every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年招收五名學徒。

apprentice.en: a person who learns a skilled job by working for someone with experience

ex.en: She was apprenticed to a famous chef.
ex.zh: 她拜一位名廚為師當學徒。

ex.en: He apprenticed with a local electrician.
ex.zh: 他跟著當地一位電工當學徒。

apprentice.en: to place someone with a skilled worker to learn a job

ex.en: Which do you like best, apples, oranges or grapes?
ex.zh: 蘋果、橘子和葡萄，你最喜歡哪一種？

ex.en: How many apples do you want me to buy?
ex.zh: 你要我買幾顆蘋果？

ex.en: Some of the apples in the box were rotten.
ex.zh: 盒子裡有些蘋果爛了。

apple.en: a round fruit with red, green or yellow skin that grows on a tree

apple.zh: the apple doesn't fall far from the tree：有其父（母）必有其子

ex.en: The apple does not fall far from the tree.
ex.zh: 有其父必有其子。

ex.en: She became a doctor like her mom; the apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
ex.zh: 她跟媽媽一樣當了醫生，真是有其母必有其女。

apple.en: used to say that children are usually like their parents

ex.en: This law is applicable to all cases.
ex.zh: 這條法律適用於所有情況。

ex.en: This discount is not applicable to sale items.
ex.zh: 這項折扣不適用於特價商品。

ex.en: Please fill in all applicable fields.
ex.zh: 請填寫所有適用的欄位。

applicable.en: having a connection to a person or situation, so that it can be used for them

ex.en: See the appendix for more details.
ex.zh: 更多細節請見附錄。

ex.en: The data is in Appendix B.
ex.zh: 資料在附錄 B。

appendix.en: extra information given at the end of a book or document

ex.en: He had his appendix removed last year.
ex.zh: 他去年割了盲腸。

ex.en: The doctor said Tom's appendix was inflamed.
ex.zh: 醫生說湯姆的闌尾發炎了。

appendix.en: a small tube-shaped part of the body attached to the bowel

ex.en: This is all very approximate.
ex.zh: 這些全都只是很粗略的估計。

ex.en: The approximate cost is 5,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 大約的費用是五千元。

ex.en: Can you give me an approximate arrival time?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我大概幾點到嗎？

approximate.en: close to the exact amount but not completely exact

ex.en: The story approximates to historical truth.
ex.zh: 這個故事很接近歷史真相。

ex.en: The results approximate our predictions.
ex.zh: 結果和我們的預測很接近。

approximate.en: to be nearly the same as something

ex.en: I'm a little apprehensive about the job interview.
ex.zh: 我對這次工作面試有點不安。

ex.en: Many employees are apprehensive about the merger.
ex.zh: 許多員工對合併感到憂心。

apprehensive.en: worried that something bad may happen

ex.en: I have a good appetite today.
ex.zh: 我今天胃口很好。

ex.en: Thanks to you I've lost my appetite.
ex.zh: 托你的福，我一點胃口都沒了。

ex.en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
ex.zh: 看到新鮮的龍蝦，我就有了食慾。

appetite.en: the feeling of wanting to eat food

ex.en: Algeria's appetite for sugar is increasing.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞對糖的需求正在增加。

ex.en: Investors have little appetite for risk right now.
ex.zh: 投資人目前不太願意承擔風險。

appetite.en: a strong wish or need for something

ex.en: Start behaving appropriately.
ex.zh: 請開始表現得體一點。

ex.en: Please dress appropriately for the interview.
ex.zh: 面試請穿著得體。

ex.en: The issue was handled appropriately.
ex.zh: 這個問題處理得很恰當。

appropriately.en: in a way that is right or suitable for the situation

ex.en: This figure is only an approximation.
ex.zh: 這個數字只是概略的估計。

ex.en: Can you give me a rough approximation of the cost?
ex.zh: 你能大概估算一下費用嗎？

approximation.en: a number or amount that is close to the exact one but not exact

ex.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
ex.zh: 一艘船突然從霧中出現。

ex.en: She stopped appearing in public after her accident.
ex.zh: 那次意外之後，她就不再公開露面了。

ex.en: New programmes will appear in the fall on television.
ex.zh: 秋天電視上會有新節目。

appear.en: to come into view or become seen

ex.en: There appears to be a party in that house.
ex.zh: 那間房子裡好像在開派對。

ex.en: She appears to have a lot of friends.
ex.zh: 她好像有很多朋友。

appear.en: to seem or give the impression of being

ex.en: That's the best approach to the study of English.
ex.zh: 那是學英文最好的方法。

ex.en: We need a new approach to this problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要用新方法處理這個問題。

approach.en: a way of dealing with a problem or doing something

ex.en: I was dazzled by the headlights of an approaching car.
ex.zh: 迎面而來的車頭燈讓我眼花。

ex.en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.
ex.zh: 火車快到平交道時減速並鳴笛。

approach.en: to come nearer to someone or something

ex.en: We should approach this problem from different angles.
ex.zh: 我們應該從不同角度處理這個問題。

ex.en: How should we approach the client about the delay?
ex.zh: 我們該怎麼跟客戶談延誤的事？

approach.en: to start dealing with a problem, or to speak to someone to ask for something

ex.en: Do you think it's appropriate to talk like that?
ex.zh: 你覺得那樣說話合適嗎？

ex.en: Local people can give appropriate advice.
ex.zh: 當地人可以給你適切的建議。

ex.en: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
ex.zh: 我得換衣服，因為我穿的不適合這個場合。

appropriate.en: right or suitable for a particular situation

ex.en: His music and words appeal to young people.
ex.zh: 他的音樂和歌詞很吸引年輕人。

ex.en: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
ex.zh: 私下說，湯姆的點子我不太感興趣。

ex.en: The new design should appeal to younger customers.
ex.zh: 新設計應該會吸引年輕顧客。

appeal.en: to be attractive or interesting to someone

ex.en: Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
ex.zh: 湯姆央求媽媽買新玩具給他。

ex.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
ex.zh: 被告將向上級法院上訴。

ex.en: The police appealed to the public for information.
ex.zh: 警方呼籲民眾提供線索。

appeal.en: to ask strongly for help, or to ask a higher court to change a decision

ex.en: We made an appeal for support.
ex.zh: 我們發出了尋求支持的呼籲。

ex.en: The product has wide appeal among young people.
ex.zh: 這項產品廣受年輕人喜愛。

appeal.en: a quality that makes people like something, or a strong request for help

ex.en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith live apart from each other now.
ex.zh: 史密斯夫婦現在分居了。

ex.en: He is living apart from his wife.
ex.zh: 他和太太分居。

ex.en: The two offices are about five kilometers apart.
ex.zh: 這兩間辦公室相隔大約五公里。

apart.en: separated by a distance or in different places

ex.en: Apart from my sister, my family doesn't watch TV.
ex.zh: 除了我妹妹，我家人都不看電視。

ex.en: Apart from languages, I'm also interested in technology.
ex.zh: 除了語言，我也對科技有興趣。

ex.en: Apart from some fruit, he hasn't eaten anything.
ex.zh: 除了一些水果，他什麼都沒吃。

apart.en: used to show that you are not including a person or thing

apart.zh: fall apart / take apart：解體、拆開

ex.en: My old shoes are falling apart.
ex.zh: 我的舊鞋快解體了。

ex.en: He took the computer apart to fix it.
ex.zh: 他把電腦拆開來修理。

apart.en: to break into pieces, or to separate something into its parts

ex.en: Tom has apparently done that already.
ex.zh: 湯姆好像已經做完了。

ex.en: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.
ex.zh: 看來如今沒有什麼事是不可能發生的。

ex.en: Apparently, the meeting has been canceled.
ex.zh: 聽說會議取消了。

apparently.en: according to what people say or what seems to be true

ex.en: Judging from her appearance, I think that she's rich.
ex.zh: 從她的外表看來，我想她應該很有錢。

ex.en: Don't be fooled by appearances.
ex.zh: 不要被外表騙了。

ex.en: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟長得一點都不像。

appearance.en: the way a person or thing looks to others

ex.en: The singer made a surprise appearance at the event.
ex.zh: 那位歌手意外現身活動現場。

ex.en: It was his first public appearance since the accident.
ex.zh: 這是他自意外以來首度公開露面。

appearance.en: the act of arriving or being seen somewhere

appearance.zh: keep up appearances：維持表面、撐場面

ex.en: She managed to keep up appearances.
ex.zh: 她努力維持表面上的體面。

ex.en: They kept up appearances even after the business failed.
ex.zh: 即使生意失敗了，他們還是維持表面的風光。

appearance.en: to hide a bad situation so that things seem fine to other people

ex.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會一致決定任命她為執行長。

ex.en: He was appointed ambassador to Britain.
ex.zh: 他被任命為駐英國大使。

ex.en: They appointed him as a director.
ex.zh: 他們任命他為董事。

appoint.en: to choose someone officially for a job or position

ex.en: He came five minutes behind the appointed time.
ex.zh: 他比約定的時間晚到了五分鐘。

ex.en: We met at the appointed place.
ex.zh: 我們在約定的地點碰面。

appoint.en: to decide and fix a time or place for something

ex.en: It's in times like these that the character of a person becomes apparent.
ex.zh: 正是在這種時候，一個人的品格才會顯露出來。

ex.en: It soon became apparent that the plan wouldn't work.
ex.zh: 很快就看得出這個計畫行不通。

ex.en: Despite his apparent calm, he was very nervous.
ex.zh: 他表面上很冷靜，其實非常緊張。

ex.en: The apparent cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
ex.zh: 火災的起因看來是線路故障。

apparent.en: seeming real or true but maybe not so

ex.en: She lives with him in a small apartment.
ex.zh: 她和他一起住在一間小公寓裡。

ex.en: How many rooms does she have in her apartment?
ex.zh: 她的公寓有幾個房間？

ex.en: I invited a Chinese friend to my apartment.
ex.zh: 我邀請了一位中國朋友來我的公寓。

apartment.en: a set of rooms for living in, in a building with other homes

ex.en: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
ex.zh: 他的演講立刻贏得了觀眾的掌聲。

ex.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
ex.zh: 我們為表演者鼓掌。

ex.en: The portrait of the king was unveiled and received enthusiastic applause.
ex.zh: 國王的肖像揭幕時，獲得熱烈掌聲。

applause.en: the sound of people clapping their hands to show they enjoyed something

ex.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我把這件事說清楚。

ex.en: I deeply appreciate your advice and kindness.
ex.zh: 我非常感激你的建議和好意。

appreciate.en: to feel thankful for something someone has done

ex.en: Tom appreciates modern art.
ex.zh: 湯姆欣賞現代藝術。

ex.en: I hope Tom appreciates it.
ex.zh: 希望湯姆會懂得珍惜。

appreciate.en: to enjoy something or understand its value

ex.en: The Japanese yen appreciated.
ex.zh: 日圓升值了。

ex.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
ex.zh: 新台幣升值，導致台灣出口下滑。

appreciate.en: to increase in value over time

ex.en: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
ex.zh: 我認為你應該跟她道歉。

ex.en: He apologized to the teacher for coming to school late.
ex.zh: 他為上學遲到向老師道歉。

ex.en: Tom apologized for falling asleep in class.
ex.zh: 湯姆為自己上課睡著而道歉。

apologize.en: to tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong

ex.en: We ordered spring rolls as an appetizer.
ex.zh: 我們點了春捲當開胃菜。

ex.en: The appetizers came out before the main course.
ex.zh: 開胃菜在主菜之前上桌。

appetizer.en: a small amount of food eaten before the main part of a meal

ex.en: I have an appointment with him at six.
ex.zh: 我約了他六點見面。

ex.en: I made an appointment to see him at seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 我跟他約好七點見面。

ex.en: He canceled the appointment at the last moment.
ex.zh: 他在最後一刻取消了約。

ex.en: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Lin.
ex.zh: 我想預約林醫師的門診。

appointment.en: an arranged time to meet or see someone, such as a doctor

ex.en: She announced the appointment of a new manager.
ex.zh: 她宣布任命一位新經理。

ex.en: His appointment as ambassador was approved.
ex.zh: 他的大使任命獲得批准。

appointment.en: the act of choosing someone for a job, or the job itself

ex.en: This is an appliance for drying clothes.
ex.zh: 這是用來烘乾衣服的器具。

ex.en: The apartment comes with all major appliances.
ex.zh: 這間公寓附有所有主要家電。

appliance.en: a machine used in the home, such as a washing machine

ex.en: She felt a growing apprehension as the exam date approached.
ex.zh: 考試日期愈來愈近，她愈來愈擔心。

ex.en: He waited with apprehension for the doctor's call.
ex.zh: 他憂心忡忡地等著醫生的電話。

apprehension.en: a worried feeling that something bad may happen

ex.en: The police announced the apprehension of the suspect.
ex.zh: 警方宣布嫌犯已被逮捕。

ex.en: The apprehension of the thief took only an hour.
ex.zh: 抓到那名小偷只花了一個小時。

apprehension.en: the act of catching a person who has broken the law

ex.en: The cruelty of the crime will appal anyone who reads about it.
ex.zh: 任何讀到這起罪行的人都會為其殘忍而驚駭。

ex.en: Such wasteful spending would appal most taxpayers.
ex.zh: 這種浪費的開支會讓大多數納稅人感到震驚。

ex.en: The prisoners lived in appalling conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯們生活在駭人的環境中。

ex.en: His behavior at the party was appalling.
ex.zh: 他在派對上的行為令人震驚。

ex.en: This store sells sports apparel for men, women, and children.
ex.zh: 這家店販售男裝、女裝和童裝的運動服飾。

ex.en: The company has made outdoor apparel for over thirty years.
ex.zh: 這家公司生產戶外服裝已經超過三十年了。

apparel.en: clothes, especially in a shop or business

ex.en: Mary got the nod from among some 500 applicants.
ex.zh: 瑪麗從大約 500 名應徵者中脫穎而出。

ex.en: Does the applicant have suitable abilities to carry out the job?
ex.zh: 這位應徵者有能力勝任這份工作嗎？

ex.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
ex.zh: 這個職位要求應徵者具備良好的英語口說能力。

applicant.en: a person who asks formally for a job or place

ex.en: I have my annual appraisal next week.
ex.zh: 我下週有年度考核。

ex.en: The appraisal showed that she needs more training.
ex.zh: 考核結果顯示她需要更多訓練。

appraisal.en: a meeting or report that judges how well an employee works

ex.en: We need an appraisal of the house before selling it.
ex.zh: 賣房子前我們需要先估價。

ex.en: The jeweler gave us an appraisal of the ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶商幫我們鑑定了這枚戒指的價值。

appraisal.en: a judgment of how much something is worth

ex.en: I am waiting for approval.
ex.zh: 我在等核准。

ex.en: He gave me his stamp of approval.
ex.zh: 他正式批准了我。

ex.en: The plan needs approval from the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要董事會核准。

ex.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
ex.zh: 如果您同意，我想把這份工作給他。

ex.en: Tom nodded approval.
ex.zh: 湯姆點頭表示贊同。

approval.en: a good opinion of someone or something

ex.en: The app crashed again.
ex.zh: 這款 App 又閃退了。

ex.en: Please update the app before using the new feature.
ex.zh: 使用新功能前，請先更新 App。

app.en: a computer program for a phone or other small device

ex.en: Approximately thirty young people attended.
ex.zh: 約有三十個年輕人到了。

ex.en: Tom fell approximately 30 meters.
ex.zh: 湯姆摔落了大約 30 公尺。

ex.en: Sami called at approximately six.
ex.zh: 薩米大約六點打來。

approximately.en: used to show that a number is close but not exact

ex.en: The boss has already approved of our plans.
ex.zh: 老闆已經批准了我們的計劃。

ex.en: That four-year plan has to be approved.
ex.zh: 那個四年計畫必須經過核准。

ex.en: The manager approved our plan.
ex.zh: 經理批准了我們的計劃。

approve.en: to officially agree to a plan or request

ex.en: Do you approve of what he is doing?
ex.zh: 你贊成他正在做的事嗎？

ex.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
ex.zh: 這就是我不贊成你計畫的原因。

approve.en: to think that someone or something is good or right

ex.en: Tom is thinking about applying for a better-paying job.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在考慮應徵一份薪水更好的工作。

ex.en: I haven't decided which job to apply for.
ex.zh: 我還沒決定要應徵哪份工作。

ex.en: When applying to American universities, your TOEFL score is only one factor.
ex.zh: 申請美國大學時，托福成績只是其中一項考量。

apply.en: to ask formally for a job, place or permission

ex.en: This kind of medicine can only be applied externally.
ex.zh: 這種藥物只能外用。

ex.en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside.
ex.zh: 出門前先擦防曬乳。

apply.en: to put a substance onto a surface

ex.en: This still applies to him.
ex.zh: 這點對他仍然適用。

ex.en: These rules apply to all visitors.
ex.zh: 這些規定適用於所有訪客。

apply.en: to be true for or relate to a person or situation

ex.en: The due date for submitting the application is this Friday.
ex.zh: 申請截止日是這個星期五。

ex.en: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
ex.zh: 我們的徵人廣告已經收到很多應徵申請。

ex.en: Tom filled out the job application form.
ex.zh: 湯姆填好了求職申請表。

application.en: a formal request for a job or place, or the form used for it

ex.en: The cellphone came with several applications already pre-installed.
ex.zh: 這支手機出廠時就預先安裝了幾個應用程式。

ex.en: This application lets you track your expenses.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以記錄你的花費。

application.en: a computer program that does a particular job

ex.en: He has a remarkable aptitude for music.
ex.zh: 他有非凡的音樂天分。

ex.en: She shows a natural aptitude for languages.
ex.zh: 她很有語言天分。

aptitude.en: a natural ability to learn or do something well

ex.en: The cherry blossoms are beautiful in April.
ex.zh: 四月的櫻花很美。

ex.en: My birthday is on the tenth of April.
ex.zh: 我的生日是四月十日。

ex.en: It often rains in April in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 台灣的四月常常下雨。

ex.en: I want to apologise for being late.
ex.zh: 我想為遲到向你道歉。

ex.en: He apologised to her for the misunderstanding.
ex.zh: 他為這個誤會向她道歉。

ex.en: You should apologise before things get worse.
ex.zh: 你應該在事情惡化之前道歉。

ex.en: The students set up the apparatus for the science experiment.
ex.zh: 學生們為科學實驗架設儀器。

ex.en: Firefighters wear breathing apparatus when they enter a burning building.
ex.zh: 消防員進入火場時會佩戴呼吸裝置。

applied.zh: 申請；應徵（apply 的過去式）

ex.en: She applied for a job at a local bank last week.
ex.zh: 她上週應徵了一份本地銀行的工作。

ex.en: He applied to three universities in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 他向三所台灣的大學提出申請。

applied.zh: 塗抹；應用（apply 的過去式）

ex.en: The nurse applied a cream to the rash.
ex.zh: 護理師在疹子上塗了藥膏。

ex.en: She applied what she had learned in class to her project.
ex.zh: 她把課堂上學到的東西應用在專案上。

ex.en: He studies applied mathematics at university.
ex.zh: 他在大學念應用數學。

ex.en: Applied science turns research into useful products.
ex.zh: 應用科學把研究成果變成實用的產品。

ex.en: The audience applauded for a full minute after the concert.
ex.zh: 音樂會結束後，觀眾鼓掌了整整一分鐘。

ex.en: I applaud your decision to learn a new skill.
ex.zh: 我很讚賞你決定學習一項新技能。

approved.zh: 批准、核准（approve 的過去式）

ex.en: The city council approved the plan to build a new park.
ex.zh: 市議會批准了興建新公園的計畫。

ex.en: My boss approved my request for a day off.
ex.zh: 我的主管批准了我請一天假的申請。

ex.en: This is the only approved method for cleaning the machine.
ex.zh: 這是清潔這台機器唯一經核准的方法。

ex.en: Only approved drivers are allowed to use the company car.
ex.zh: 只有經核准的駕駛才能使用公司車。

ex.en: The government approved an appropriation for the new bridge.
ex.zh: 政府核准了新橋的撥款。

ex.en: The committee discussed the appropriation of funds for schools.
ex.zh: 委員會討論了為學校撥款的事。

ex.en: Apartheid was a system of racial separation in South Africa.
ex.zh: 種族隔離制度曾是南非的一種種族分離體制。

ex.en: Many countries opposed apartheid and called for equal rights.
ex.zh: 許多國家反對種族隔離，並呼籲人人平等。

ex.en: Glass is apt to break if you drop it.
ex.zh: 玻璃掉到地上很容易碎。

ex.en: He is apt to forget names when he meets new people.
ex.zh: 他遇到新朋友時常常忘記對方的名字。

ex.en: "Cloud" is an apt name for such a soft, white cat.
ex.zh: 「雲朵」對這麼柔軟的白貓來說是個很貼切的名字。

ex.en: Her apt reply made everyone smile.
ex.zh: 她恰如其分的回答讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: The idea of a quiet weekend by the lake is very appealing.
ex.zh: 在湖邊度過寧靜週末的想法非常吸引人。

ex.en: The restaurant has an appealing menu with many fresh dishes.
ex.zh: 這間餐廳的菜單很吸引人，有許多新鮮料理。

ex.en: The puppy gave me an appealing look with its big eyes.
ex.zh: 小狗用大眼睛向我投來懇求的眼神。

ex.en: She spoke in an appealing voice, hoping he would help.
ex.zh: 她用央求的聲音說話，希望他能幫忙。

ex.en: The appellant asked the court to review the decision.
ex.zh: 上訴人請求法院重新審查這項判決。

ex.en: The judge listened to the appellant's lawyer.
ex.zh: 法官聽取了上訴人律師的陳述。

ex.en: The appellant party submitted new documents.
ex.zh: 上訴的一方提交了新的文件。

ex.en: The appellant court changed the earlier ruling.
ex.zh: 上訴法院更改了先前的裁決。

ex.en: He started a three-year apprenticeship as an electrician.
ex.zh: 他開始了為期三年的電工學徒訓練。

ex.en: An apprenticeship lets you learn a trade while earning money.
ex.zh: 學徒制讓你邊賺錢邊學一門手藝。

ex.en: She put on an apron before she started cooking.
ex.zh: 她在開始煮飯前先穿上圍裙。

ex.en: His apron was covered in flour.
ex.zh: 他的圍裙沾滿了麵粉。

ex.en: We arrived at the appointed time.
ex.zh: 我們在約定的時間抵達。

ex.en: Everyone gathered at the appointed place.
ex.zh: 大家都聚集在指定的地點。

appointed.zh: 任命；指派（appoint 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The company appointed a new manager last month.
ex.zh: 公司上個月任命了一位新經理。

ex.en: She was appointed head of the committee.
ex.zh: 她被任命為委員會主席。

ex.en: The ape swung from branch to branch.
ex.zh: 那隻猿從一根樹枝盪到另一根樹枝。

ex.en: Gorillas and chimpanzees are both apes.
ex.zh: 大猩猩和黑猩猩都是猿類。

ex.en: We watched an ape eat fruit at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我們在動物園看一隻猿在吃水果。

ex.en: The little boy aped his father's walk.
ex.zh: 小男孩模仿他爸爸走路的樣子。

ex.en: Many brands ape the style of famous designers.
ex.zh: 許多品牌模仿知名設計師的風格。

ex.en: I was appalled by the way he spoke to the waiter.
ex.zh: 我對他對待服務生的說話方式感到震驚又反感。

ex.en: Parents were appalled at the dirty classrooms.
ex.zh: 家長對骯髒的教室感到震驚。

ex.en: The terrible news appalled the whole town.
ex.zh: 這個可怕的消息讓全鎮的人震驚。

ex.en: His rude behavior appalled his teachers.
ex.zh: 他無禮的行為讓老師們震驚。

ex.en: Peter was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.
ex.zh: 彼得是耶穌的十二使徒之一。

ex.en: The church is named after an apostle.
ex.zh: 這座教堂是以一位使徒命名的。

ex.en: The tickets cost ten dollars apiece.
ex.zh: 這些票每張十美元。

ex.en: Each of the kids got two cookies, so they had two apiece.
ex.zh: 每個孩子分到兩片餅乾，也就是一人兩片。
